sources.description: Monitoring alerts raised against authentication objectives.
Release and maintenance events recorded by the delivery pipeline.
Authentication log excerpts retained for the incident window.
Distributed trace summaries sampled during the incident.
Responder messages from the incident channel.
Ticket activity linked to the incident.

records.title: auth-service login failure ratio above objective
records.body: Alert auth-login-failure-ratio fired at 07:05:12Z. Failed logins reached 0.31 of attempts against an objective of 0.02. The alert aggregates all regions and does not break the ratio down by region.

records.title: scheduled network maintenance window opens
records.body: Scheduled maintenance window for rack replacement in region eu-west opened at 07:00:00Z, five minutes and twelve seconds before alert-6603. The maintenance record states that the affected racks host batch analytics capacity only, and that no authentication or session-store capacity is placed in them.

records.title: session-store client library upgrade
records.body: Release deployed at 06:41:30Z upgrading the auth-service session-store client from 3.2.1 to 4.0.0. The 4.0.0 release notes state that the default key serialization changed from string to binary, and that mixed-version fleets require an explicit compatibility flag.

records.title: session lookup misses in us-east
records.body: auth-service us-east: session lookup returned not_found for keys written before 06:41:30Z. Rate 0.30 of attempts. Sessions written after the upgrade resolve normally; sessions written before it do not.

records.title: log shipper down for eu-west
records.body: Log ingestion reports that the shipper for auth-service in region eu-west has been down since 06:52:00Z. No auth-service log lines from eu-west are retained for the incident window.

records.title: sampled failing login trace
records.body: Trace 9c40ab from region us-east: POST /login total 88ms. Span session.lookup 6ms returned not_found for a key written at 05:12:00Z. The request then returned 401 without contacting the identity provider.

records.title: responder attributes failures to maintenance
records.body: Responder G: 'The eu-west maintenance window opened five minutes before this. Let us page the network team and get the window aborted.'

records.title: responder attributes failures to the identity provider
records.body: Responder H: 'I think the upstream identity provider is rejecting our tokens. We should open a ticket with them before we touch anything on our side.'

records.title: responder points at the session-store client upgrade
records.body: Responder I: 'The traces never reach the identity provider, they fail at session lookup. We upgraded the session-store client to 4.0.0 at 06:41 and that release changes key serialization. Sessions written before the upgrade are unreadable by the new client.'

records.title: mitigation applied
records.body: Responder I: 'Set the compatibility flag on the session-store client and restarted auth-service in us-east at 07:58:00Z. Failure ratio in us-east is back to 0.01. We still cannot see eu-west.'

records.title: INC-9930 opened
records.body: INC-9930 opened at 07:07:00Z, severity 1, title 'Users cannot log in'. The ticket does not record which regions were affected, and no per-region breakdown was added before resolution.

records.title: INC-9930 resolution note
records.body: INC-9930 marked resolved at 08:40:00Z. Resolution note records the us-east mitigation only. Whether eu-west was affected during the same window was never established, because no eu-west authentication logs were retained.
